VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design to enhance the big-screen experience.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has released technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, expanding its accessory ecosystem.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed the company is developing multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at an upcoming announcement at Connect.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack has reiterated his $1 million guarantee to support VR ports of id Software's classic games, urging Microsoft to take action.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: The fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game Squingle Arcade is now available for free on Meta Quest, featuring hand tracking support.

VR.title: ‘Tomb Raider’ VR Reportedly Cancelled According to Leaked Images & Video
VR.summary: Reports reveal that a Tomb Raider VR game was in development at Vertigo Games Amsterdam before being canceled earlier this year.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the theft of trade secrets related to hardware development.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following user backlash.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google has introduced a new feature that labels ads created or edited using AI, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down ChatGPT Atlas, its browser tool, less than a year after its launch.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to place AI data center compute units in customers' homes, incentivizing participation.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: OpenAI's Fidji Simo is stepping down from her role as AGI chief due to health issues, transitioning to a part-time advisory position.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's group has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion, with Khosla set to sell his 49ers stake.

NFL.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
NFL.summary: Aaron Rodgers aims to become the fifth quarterback in NFL history to surpass 70,000 passing yards in what he claims is his final season.

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Bears have signed third-round tight end Sam Roush, completing their draft class signings.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald has been spotted working out at the Rams' facility, fueling speculation about a potential unretirement.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla's wife, Neeru, will be controlling owner of Seahawks
NFL.summary: Neeru Khosla will become the controlling owner of the Seahawks, with her son expected to play a significant role in the organization.

NFL.title: Daniel Jones is "cleared to do everything" and "feeling good"
NFL.summary: Daniel Jones has been cleared for full participation in training camp, showing positive progress in his recovery.
